title: Readme upkeep: everything that landed today is reachable from the readme chain

chat.text: A script checks that every page and doc that landed today (the catalog, the voice surfaces, InstanceTree, the models page, AITask's new home, the architecture and repo-size docs, and the rest) is linked from its parent readme and that every readme in the chain stays under 100 lines; the misses get one link line each, and readmes that still name retired things get the one-line fix.
